dimensions.name: Acceptance criteria
dimensions.evidence: The #90 retrospective is recorded with the missing-effort caveat; the absolute-XDG/unset/relative cache regression has red/green evidence and restricted-container reproduction; the published CLI 0.12.53/SDLC 0.21.4 tuple and exact #99 grant are adopted. The issue and native qualification remain explicitly open.

dimensions.name: Implementation completeness
dimensions.evidence: The authorized maintenance slice is complete: cache selection changed without altering scan controls, official installers update owned Lighthouse projections, and the narrowly scoped #99 grant replaces the completed #90 override. Future #99 delivery and #88 qualification are correctly left pending.

dimensions.name: Tests
dimensions.evidence: Supplied candidate receipt records npm ci and full verify passing (35 Node, 38 .NET, 12 browser tests); scanner regression is recorded red on old behavior and 17/17 passing in the pinned restricted container, including ignored-secret detection and redaction.

dimensions.name: Quality checks
dimensions.evidence: Candidate receipt records successful Lighthouse verify, lighthouse-guard verify, gh-aw compile validation, and actionlint for App preflight and verify workflows. Current-head hosted Verify Lighthouse foundation and verify checks both completed successfully (runs 42367879225 and 42367879103).

dimensions.name: Security
dimensions.evidence: Scanner checksum and binary-version validation, ignored-secret coverage/redaction, lock ownership and scanning inputs are retained. Policy-control evidence covers frozen verification inputs, scope denials, repository-only App token/revocation and owner-only preflight. No authentication or production behavior is introduced; eight existing npm advisories are disclosed.

dimensions.name: Architecture / design conformance
dimensions.evidence: Cache placement and published delivery-adapter adoption do not change application trust boundaries. The change preserves ProductShape/architecture authority and does not expand auth, mount, concurrency, or production scope.

dimensions.name: Documentation
dimensions.evidence: The approved #90 retrospective, maintenance evidence/limitations, and continuing native qualification gate are documented in docs/reviews/issue-90.md and docs/delivery/evidence/issue-88/.

dimensions.name: Product / spec consistency
dimensions.evidence: The maintenance changes no product behavior or accepted ProductShape baseline. Existing OpenSpec/ProductShape verification is included in the successful full verify receipt.

dimensions.name: Evidence
dimensions.evidence: Source-bound candidate checks and current-head hosted CI receipts are supplied. Evidence explicitly distinguishes this prerequisite maintenance from native qualification; no unavailable native run or human/provider qualification is claimed.

dimensions.name: Human review
dimensions.evidence: Independent review of this exact candidate head completed; the change preserves the owner-approved boundaries and reports no actionable defect.

dimensions.name: Known limitations
dimensions.evidence: The original #90 native run remains blocked; default-branch preflight and a fresh #99 native plan-to-post-merge chain remain pending. These are explicitly stated as prerequisites, not passed qualification or grounds to reject this maintenance candidate.
